subject: Unify duplicated FEATURES and category maps behind a fit_scope parameter
description: The 14-element FEATURES list and the SELECTED/CAT_FILE category map are copy-pasted across forecast_service.py, srq4_experiment.py and srq2_synthesis.py. Deployment mode (train on all data, predict beyond) vs evaluation mode (train on train+val, predict test) is a legitimate distinction - implement it as one function with a fit_scope parameter rather than two copies.
activeForm: Unifying duplicated feature and category definitions
